completeness.why: getNextDate passes its raw skipWeekend/weekendSolve to applyWeekendRule and keeps only its own noSkipWeekend option (a variation unique to that site), and getUpcomingDates passes its raw config fields: both full. Both createScheduleList sites call applyWeekendRule but keep their own outer `dateConditions.value.skipWeekend ? ... : nextBaseDate` ternary, so whether the rule applies is still decided there (and twice): partial.

interface.why: applyWeekendRule(date, skipWeekend, solveMode) parameterises exactly the real variation, each caller maps its own mode field name, noSkipWeekend stays explicit at the one caller that has it, and getDateWithSkippedWeekend is made private; minor looseness in accepting undefined solveMode.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is re-expressed in disguise; the leftover skipWeekend ternaries in schedule-template.ts createScheduleList are an incomplete migration, not a reshaped copy.
